QF.id: XVI Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_50

question.text: Clearing members must maintain settlement accounts at:

answer.text: Designated clearing banks — separate from regular business accounts

explanation.text: The Logic: Clearing members must maintain a settlement account with an empanelled clearing bank at the designated branch and use it exclusively for clearing and settlement, as described in the source workbook. Members typically open dedicated settlement and client accounts at the clearing bank. The Trap: Members cannot use any bank of their choice; the bank must be a designated/empanelled clearing bank. The exchange treasury does not hold member settlement accounts, and personal savings accounts are not permitted for clearing and settlement.
